caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper materials support compound names/scaffold substitutions and activity values, but do not provide normalized DBAASP sequence/terminal-modification identity rows; these remain source_conflict.
Some DBAASP species-level rows summarize several clinical isolate MIC values as ranges; final activity keeps isolate-level source rows and database audit notes the aggregate linkage.
Hemolysis, NPN, and time-kill figures are locally available, but exact curve/bar values are not tabulated in extracted text; claims stay qualitative where exact local values are unavailable.
The packet supplement parser reports no structured spreadsheet tables, but the OA package contains a local supplementary PDF whose text/layout supports the required owner-layer repair.
